caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of furniture, specifically a settee, with an upholstered seat, back, and sides. The upholstery fabric is a rich, ornate red with an intricate floral pattern in varying shades of red and pink. The settee features a gently curving back that rises to two points at each side, swooping down into high scrolled armrests. The legs and exposed wooden frame are dark brown, straight, and square-shaped, with decorative engravings or patterns visible on the front surfaces. The legs are connected by a series of horizontal and diagonal stretchers forming a rigid rectangular base. The background of the drawing is a plain beige or light tan color, with a thin rectangular border sketched around the settee, defining the limits of the drawing space.
title: Sofa
